notation: A byte vector is an array of segments concatenated in order: {"hex": ".."}, {"utf8": ".."} or {"repeat_hex": "..", "count": N}. limits defaults to default_limits. encode names the encoder (plain: one frame; parts: frame_part encoding) whose output for payload is wire_parts, one byte vector per buffer. A decoder fed wire (or the concatenated wire_parts) yields frames, or fails with error.kind on push or on finish; error.frames_before are the frames a decoder fed one byte at a time delivers first.

vectors.name: plain_hello
vectors.summary: A plain frame: u32 big-endian length, then the bytes.

vectors.name: plain_auth_frame
vectors.summary: A whole auth frame as a client sends it.

vectors.name: plain_empty
vectors.summary: A zero-length plain frame decodes to an empty payload.

vectors.name: plain_multibyte_utf8
vectors.summary: Lengths count UTF-8 bytes, not characters.

vectors.name: parts_encoder_leaves_a_fitting_frame_plain
vectors.summary: frame_part encoding of a payload that fits one frame is the plain frame.

vectors.name: parts_one_byte_over
vectors.summary: One byte over the frame limit: a full part 0 and a one-byte FIN part 1.

vectors.name: parts_exact_multiple
vectors.summary: A payload of exactly two frames: two full parts, the second flagged FIN.

vectors.name: parts_split_mid_character
vectors.summary: A part boundary may split a UTF-8 character; only the reassembled frame is decoded.

vectors.name: parts_at_the_reassembly_limit
vectors.summary: A logical frame exactly at the reassembly limit is accepted.

vectors.name: default_largest_plain_frame
vectors.summary: With the default limits a 1 MiB payload is still one plain frame.

vectors.name: default_one_byte_over_a_frame
vectors.summary: With the default limits 1 MiB + 1 bytes go out as a full 1 MiB part 0 and a one-byte FIN part 1.

vectors.name: encode_plain_too_large
vectors.summary: The plain encoder refuses a payload over the frame limit.

vectors.name: encode_parts_over_the_reassembly_limit
vectors.summary: The part encoder refuses a payload over the reassembly limit.

vectors.name: back_to_back_frames
vectors.summary: Two plain frames in one chunk decode in order.

vectors.name: plain_parts_plain
vectors.summary: Plain frames before and after a part sequence decode in order.

vectors.name: part_indexes_restart_per_logical_frame
vectors.summary: Each logical frame's parts start again at index 0.

vectors.name: plain_length_over_the_limit
vectors.summary: A plain length prefix over the frame limit is refused from the prefix alone.

vectors.name: plain_length_high_bit
vectors.summary: A length with the top bit set (not the sentinel) is an oversized plain frame.

vectors.name: part_out_of_sequence
vectors.summary: A gap in part indexes is refused.

vectors.name: part_repeated
vectors.summary: A repeated part index is refused.

vectors.name: part_sequence_not_starting_at_zero
vectors.summary: A sequence must start at part 0.

vectors.name: plain_frame_mid_sequence
vectors.summary: A plain frame inside a part sequence is refused.

vectors.name: part_unknown_flag_bit
vectors.summary: A flag bit other than FIN is refused.

vectors.name: part_corrupt_flags
vectors.summary: Corrupt flags (0x7e) are refused.

vectors.name: part_zero_length
vectors.summary: A part must carry at least one byte.

vectors.name: part_length_over_the_frame_limit
vectors.summary: A part longer than the frame limit is refused from its header alone.

vectors.name: reassembly_over_the_limit
vectors.summary: A part that would take the reassembled frame past the limit is refused from its header.

vectors.name: pre_auth_reassembly_limit
vectors.summary: Before auth the reassembly limit is one frame, so a second part is refused.

vectors.name: error_after_a_good_frame
vectors.summary: Frames before a protocol error are delivered when they arrive in earlier chunks.

vectors.name: truncated_length_prefix
vectors.summary: A stream that ends inside a length prefix is truncated.

vectors.name: truncated_payload
vectors.summary: A stream that ends inside a payload is truncated.

vectors.name: truncated_part_header
vectors.summary: A stream that ends inside a part header is truncated.

vectors.name: truncated_mid_sequence
vectors.summary: A stream that ends between the parts of one logical frame is truncated.

vectors.name: invalid_utf8_payload
vectors.summary: A complete frame whose payload is not UTF-8 is refused.
vectors.kotlin_divergence: The Kotlin codec decodes malformed UTF-8 leniently (U+FFFD replacement) instead of refusing it.
